result_text:
I fixed the three broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer`, and the module's tests pass: 334 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped.

- **`GeneratedConventions.java`**:
  - The pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now match `.htm` as well as `.html` and `.xhtml`. The alternation had `html|html` where `html|htm` was meant.
  - The .NET documentation rule is now `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
  - The JavaScript `// Generated by …` rule is now `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`**: the Gradle rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/DefaultConventionsMatchTest.java`. It checks that the fixed rules match the intended files, that the existing matches still work (Doxygen `.html`, `.xhtml` with a generator meta tag, `build.gradle`), and that ordinary `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out. Nothing is committed.
